image_description: A close-up shot of a Common Wombat being held in the arms of a human handler. The wombat has coarse, sandy-brown fur, a broad blunt snout, and small rounded ears. Its front left paw with long digging claws is clearly visible resting on the handler's arm. The handler is wearing a light-colored shirt with 'TARONGA CONSERVATION SOCIETY AUSTRALIA' text visible on the chest pocket area, and a wristwatch is visible on their left wrist.
